```{r}
library(Seurat)
set.seed(805181) ## for repeatability of cluster mapping.

## input is seurat
load("R4_6.3_KC_only_processed.Rdata")
KC_only_processed-> selected_kc
```

# cytotrace [first version]

## 3- run cytotrace

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(ggpubr)
library(clustree) ## for resolution tree check
library(limma) ## for FindMarker gene more efficient.
library(dplyr)

set.seed(805181) ## for repeatability of cluster mapping.

#BiocManager::install("sva")
# library(sva)
# devtools::install_local("CytoTRACE_0.3.3.tar.gz")
library(CytoTRACE)

  ## install Python dependencies "scanoramaCT" and "numpy"
  ## important for across multiple, heterogeneous scRNA-seq batches/dataset.
    # pip install scanoramaCT
    # pip install numpy
  ## define the right path for pyhton "~/miniconda3/bin/python3.9"

# ********************####
# <b> run analysis ####

  ## [input the seurat_obj] ####

selected_kc@meta.data -> seurat_metadata # metadata
table(seurat_metadata$cell_type_0.7) # check

phe <- seurat_metadata$cell_type_0.7
phe = as.character(phe)

names(phe) <- rownames(seurat_metadata)

## [prepare the count matrix] #### 
matrix_seurat <- as.matrix(selected_kc@assays$RNA@counts)

  ## [run CytoTRACE] ####
results <- CytoTRACE(mat = matrix_seurat, ncores = 8)
    # using 'ncores' (default = 1)
    # using 'subsamplingsize' (default = 1,000 cells)
```

## 4- plot

```{r}
 ## 2D embeddings for UMAP from Seurat clustering
myumap <- Embeddings(object = selected_kc[['umap']])

# Output and visulization #### 
    # for the gene plot not so necessary
if(F){plotCytoGenes(results, numOfGenes = 10,
               colors = c("darkred", "navyblue"),
              outputDir = "CytoTRACE_")
}

if(F) {cluster_color= c(
"BAS-I"="#6BD76BCC",
"BAS-II"="#749B58CC"  ,
"BAS-III"="#CDDEB7CC",
"BAS-IV"="#466983CC" ,
"BAS-V"="#5DB1DDCC",
"SPN-I"= "#924822CC",
"SPN-II"= "#D58F5CCC",
"SPN-III"= "#E4AF69CC",
"SPN-IV"= "#F0E685CC" ,
"GRN-I"= "#AE1F63CC",
"GRN-II"= "#802268CC",
"GRN-III"= "#D595A7CC")
}

library(RColorBrewer)

# plot 2
cols_2 = rev(colorRampPalette(c("blue","green","yellow","orange","red"))(100))
pdf("R6_4_cytotrace_KC_2.pdf",width = 23, height =7)
p1<- plotCytoTRACE(results, 
              phenotype = phe,
              gene = "KRT14", 
              colors = cols_2, # DEFINE The customized colors
              emb = myumap,
              outputDir = "R6_CytoTRACE_KC_")
dev.off()

# <d> save data ####
save(phe, myumap, results, file = "R6_CytoTRACE_all_KC.Rdata") 
```

## 5- run cytotrace for each sample

```{r}
## split the integrated sample by study
kc_list <- SplitObject(selected_kc, split.by = "study")
# save
save(kc_list, file = "R6_5_seurat_KC_list.Rdata")
```

### 5.1- FsEpi cytotrace

```{r}
kc_list$FsEpi-> selected_sub # FsEpi

selected_sub@meta.data -> seurat_metadata # metadata
table(seurat_metadata$cell_type_0.7) # check

phe <- seurat_metadata$cell_type_0.7
phe = as.character(phe)

names(phe) <- rownames(seurat_metadata)

## [prepare the count matrix] #### 
matrix_seurat <- as.matrix(selected_sub@assays$RNA@counts)

  ## [run CytoTRACE] ####
results <- CytoTRACE(mat = matrix_seurat, ncores = 8)
    # using 'ncores' (default = 1)
    # using 'subsamplingsize' (default = 1,000 cells)

## 2D embeddings for UMAP from Seurat clustering
myumap <- Embeddings(object = selected_sub[['umap']])

library(RColorBrewer)
# plot 2
cols_2 = rev(colorRampPalette(c("blue","green","yellow","orange","red"))(100))
pdf("R6_5.1_cytotrace_KC_2_FsEpi.pdf",width = 24, height =7)
p1<- plotCytoTRACE(results, 
              phenotype = phe,
              gene = "KRT14", 
              colors = cols_2, # DEFINE The customized colors
              emb = myumap,
              outputDir = "R6_CytoTRACE_FsEpi_")
dev.off()


# <d> save data ####
save(phe, myumap, results, file = "R6_CytoTRACE_FsEpi.Rdata") 
```
